subject: Pricing follow-up: committed-use options & startup discount (Novaflow)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Call recap + committed-use options (Novaflow)

Hi Aisha, great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use: embedding + chat reranking for knowledge retrieval (customer support automation).
- Expected volume: ~8-12M tokens/month in steady-state (peaks ~15M).
- Main constraints: procurement budget of ~$40-60k/year, prefers predictable monthly spend and 99th pctl latency SLAs.

Pricing assumptions / unit economics we discussed
- Public hosted base list: ~$1,200 per 1M tokens (baseline for reference).
- 12-month committed-use (prepaid) example: $900 per 1M tokens (~25% off list).
- 36-month committed-use: $700 per 1M tokens (~42% off list).
- Startup program: qualifying startups get credits + ~40-50% off first year consumption (structured on a case basis).

Rough example (you mentioned ~10M tokens/mo):
- 10M/mo = 120M tokens/year -> at $900/1M = $108,000/year (prepaid 12-mo).

Options / asks
1) Can you confirm the expected steady-state monthly tokens (best guess: 8 / 10 / 12M)?
2) Do you qualify for the startup program (YC, < $5M ARR, <24 months since incorporation)? If so, we can pull a program quote.
3) Which procurement path is preferable: 12-month prepaid, multi-year committed (2-3 years) with staged discounts, or monthly usage with lower commitment?

Attached: Redwood_PRICING_NovaFlow_v1.pdf (summary sheet). I also created a quick 12/36-month sketch in HubSpot; link below.

Next steps
- If you can confirm tokens and program eligibility, I'll send a formal committed-use quote (with PO/DocuSign) to match your procurement cadence.
- Ben (cc) will scope any technical qs or reserved capacity notes.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0123

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call recap + committed-use options (Novaflow)

Thanks Marissa, nice recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Tokens: finance is using a working estimate of 10M tokens/month for our first production year (we may be conservative at launch).
2) Budget: current procurement target is ~$50k/year (that's what we can get approved quickly).
3) Startup program: we are YC-adjacent but not a YC company; we have <$3M ARR and were incorporated in 2024. Happy to share docs if that helps.

Questions:
- At 10M/mo, the 12-mo example ($900/1M) comes to ~$108k/year, which is above our $50k target. Can you provide a 12-mo and 36-mo quote that gets us closer to ~$50k/year (or suggest structure that fits procurement, e.g., lower unit price for multi-year prepaid, usage tiers, or apply startup credits)?
- Any options to reduce effective token consumption (quantization/encoder optimizations, batching) that would materially change unit economics?

Can we do a quick 20-minute call tomorrow to go over tradeoffs?

Aisha
Aisha Khan, Head of Ops
Novaflow
procurement@novaflow.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call recap + committed-use options (Novaflow)

Thanks Aisha, good context. Short answers first, then two concrete proposals: 

Token reduction levers
- Quantization / smaller model variant: 10-20% token reduction on some workloads (depends on prompt strategy).
- Prefix/KV caching for bursty sessions: can reduce effective billed tokens for repeated context by ~15-30% depending on session patterns.
- Batching and server-side truncation: typically helps but not dramatic for conversational workloads.

Pricing proposals (to align with ~$50k/year target) - these are sketch quotes for discussion: 

Option A - Startup program + 12-month accelerated credit
- Eligibility check required (based on ARR/incorporation).
- Proposal: 50% off list for first year up to $60k in credits + 20% off committed unit price after credits.
- Effective first year spend (if approved): ~$48k net (assuming 10M/mo baseline, credits applied to first consumption).

Option B - 36-month prepaid strategic commitment
- 36-mo prepaid for 10M/mo (360M total) at $550 per 1M tokens = $198k total -> $66k/year equivalent.
- If Novaflow signs as a strategic partner & agrees to case-study/marketing collaboration we can consider an additional 15% off -> $187k total -> ~$62k/year. Still above $50k but closer.

Option C - 24-month blended with usage tiers
- Year 1: 10M/mo at $700/1M (prepaid) -> $84k year 1.
- Year 2: volume floor reduces to 7M/mo guaranteed at $600/1M -> $50k year 2.
- This splits risk and reduces initial cash outlay if you expect ramping.

Notes:
- I attached an updated spreadsheet (Novaflow_committed-use_quote.xlsx) with line-item math.
- If you can confirm program eligibility (incorporation date + ARR statement), I'll escalate the startup credit path - that's likely the cleanest way to hit ~$50k net in year 1.

Next steps
- Can you share the incorporation date and ARR range (or confirm eligibility)? I'll kick off the program route immediately.
- Happy to hop on a 20-minute call today/tomorrow to walk numbers and legal/PO flow.

Thanks,
Marissa
